author: artlbv
body:
#### PR description:

`L1TrackFastJetProducer::fillDescriptions` declared `L1PVertexInputTag` instead of the `L1TrackInputTag` read by the constructor, and never registered the description (`descriptions.add...` was missing). The module configuration was therefore not validated and no cfi was generated from the description.

This PR declares the correct parameter, registers the description with the default label and sets the `coneSize` default to 0.4, as in `l1tTrackFastJets_cfi`.

No change in the output: all configurations in the release already set all three parameters.

#### PR validation:

- `l1tTrackFastJets`, `l1tTrackFastJetsExtended` and the generated `l1TrackFastJetProducer_cfi` pass the parameter validation in `cmsRun`
- a configuration with an unknown parameter is now rejected
- `scram b code-format` clean

#### If this PR is a backport please specify the original PR and why you need to backport that PR. If this PR will be backported please specify to which release cycle the backport is meant for:

Not a backport, no backport needed.
title: Fix the parameter description of L1TrackFastJetProducer
